title: seeFinancialData OFF strips pricing from PDF endpoints (LinesDetailProvider path)
preconds: Build with CRP-BE-09 deployed. Test user with seeFinancialData OFF.
steps:
1. Authenticate as test user.
2. Hit GET on a WO PDF download endpoint.
3. Open the downloaded PDF.
4. Search the PDF text for any dollar amounts, labor rates, or part costs.
expected:
PDF renders without any pricing data. No $ amounts, no rate columns, no margins.
Step 4: search returns no hits for currency.
